Keep the reference's coarse dark painted sprite aesthetic, with smaller chunked highlights rather than glossy smooth photographic leather. Keep the original atlas's exact 1086x1448 dimensions, 362-pixel column widths, row boundaries 0,312,580,876,1156,1448, all hand positions, silhouettes, pose angles, sizes, finger configurations, and one/two cartridge counts/positions. Keep all remaining pixels/empty gaps and registration unchanged as far as possible. Actual transparent alpha background, no background, no text, no labels, no gun, no extra limbs.
